economy.summary: His campaign says he is fighting to protect working families and seniors from rising costs, supports raising the minimum wage to $15 per hour, and backs investment in public transportation and Pre-K Counts funding.
economy.short: Supports $15 minimum wage; backs protecting families from rising costs.

taxes.summary: Supports property tax relief, including expanding property tax rebates for seniors, and says increased state basic education funding reduces reliance on local property taxes.
taxes.short: Supports property tax relief and expanded senior tax rebates.

abortion.summary: Says access to reproductive care, including family planning, IVF, and abortion services, should be a fundamental right. His campaign says he will defend abortion access, oppose attempts to outlaw it in Pennsylvania, and preserve women's health clinics.
abortion.short: Supports abortion access; opposes attempts to outlaw it in Pennsylvania.

education.summary: Supports increased state basic education funding, including $750 million in basic education funding and $225 million directed to the lowest-spending districts, raising minimum teacher salaries, expanding technical and trade school options, and increased special education and school safety funding.
education.short: Supports increased school funding, higher teacher salaries, trade schools.

healthcare.summary: His campaign says he voted to make prescriptions more affordable and set price limits, supports reducing premiums through the state health insurance exchange, and backs expanded coverage for pre-existing conditions and increased funding for primary care and health departments.
healthcare.short: Voted to lower prescription costs; supports reducing insurance premiums.

energy.summary: Endorsed by Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, whose endorsement page says he supports fully funding the Department of Environmental Protection, backs a severance tax with increased oversight and fees for drillers, and co-sponsored legislation to transition Pennsylvania to 100% renewable energy by 2050.
energy.short: Co-sponsored 100% renewable-by-2050 bill; supports DEP funding, severance tax.

guns.summary: Supports universal background checks for long gun purchases, lost-and-stolen firearm reporting legislation, safe gun storage requirements, and Extreme Risk Protection Orders, along with state funding for local law enforcement and violence intervention programs.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks, safe storage, red-flag orders.
